criteria.criterion: An active Buy-It-Now page yields its title, a numeric price and currency, its condition, and an active status.
criteria.plannedImplementation: EbayItemPageParser.Parse parses the captured item page with AngleSharp and returns an ItemPageListing: read h1.x-item-title__mainTitle for Title, span.x-price-primary__price for a non-zero decimal Price and its currency symbol, div.x-item-condition-text for Condition, and default Status to Active when div.x-photos-cvip > span.ux-textspans is neither SOLD nor ENDED.
criteria.plannedVerification: BuyItNowPageExposesTitlePriceCurrencyConditionAndActiveStatusTests.Should_expose_the_title_price_currency_condition_and_active_status parses an unquoted-attribute Buy-It-Now fixture and asserts Title equals 'Apple iPhone 15 Pro 256GB', Price equals 749.99m, Currency equals '£', Condition equals 'Pre-owned' and Status equals 'Active'. At base Parse throws NotImplementedException, so the assertions fail on the missing behaviour. No existing check parses item pages; EbaySearchParser only covers search cards.
materialConcerns: raw captures use unquoted attributes so the parser must tolerate them
currency is carried as the symbol shown in the price text, matching ListingSummary.Currency
the page is not persisted by this work item, so no schema or migration impact

criteria.criterion: An active auction page yields an auction buying format.
criteria.plannedImplementation: EbayItemPageParser.Parse detects the auction marker div.x-bid-price in the captured page and sets ItemPageListing.BuyingFormat to 'Auction', while a Buy-It-Now marker div.x-bin-price maps to 'Buy It Now'.
criteria.plannedVerification: AuctionPageExposesAuctionBuyingFormatTests.Should_report_an_auction_buying_format parses an unquoted-attribute fixture carrying div.x-bid-price and asserts BuyingFormat equals 'Auction'. At base Parse throws NotImplementedException so the assertion fails on the missing behaviour. No existing check reads item-page buying format; EbaySearchParser's card-level match is a different page shape.
materialConcerns: the auction marker must win over any default so an auction is not reported as Buy It Now
the buying-format vocabulary reuses the 'Auction' value already used by ListingSummary.BuyingFormat

criteria.criterion: A sold page yields a sold status, the sold price, and the sold date.
criteria.plannedImplementation: EbayItemPageParser.Parse reads the status badge div.x-photos-cvip > span.ux-textspans, sets Status to 'Sold' for SOLD, reads div.x-item-condensed-card__sold-price for the SoldPrice decimal, and extracts the sold date text from div.d-top-panel-message ('This listing sold on Fri, 11 Sep at 6:09 PM.') into SoldDate without the 'sold on ' prefix or trailing period.
criteria.plannedVerification: SoldPageExposesSoldStatusPriceAndDateTests.Should_report_sold_status_the_sold_price_and_the_sold_date parses an unquoted-attribute sold fixture and asserts Status equals 'Sold', SoldPrice equals 180.50m, and SoldDate equals 'Fri, 11 Sep at 6:09 PM'. At base Parse throws NotImplementedException so the assertions fail on the missing behaviour. No existing check derives sold status or sold date from an item page.
materialConcerns: sold date is exposed as the captured display text rather than a parsed DateTime to avoid a locale-dependent conversion
status must be content-derived because ended pages can return HTTP 404 with a full body
sold price is separate from the active Price field

criteria.criterion: An ended page whose price displays as `0.00` yields no price rather than zero.
criteria.plannedImplementation: EbayItemPageParser.Parse maps a parsed active price of zero to a null Price so a placeholder 0.00 on an ended page is not recorded as a real price; ended status is read from the ENDED status badge.
criteria.plannedVerification: EndedPageWithZeroPriceExposesNoPriceTests.Should_report_no_price_when_an_ended_page_displays_zero parses an unquoted-attribute ended fixture whose span.x-price-primary__price is '£0.00' and asserts the returned listing is a listing with Price equal to null. At base Parse throws NotImplementedException so the assertion fails on the missing behaviour. No existing check covers zero-price suppression.
materialConcerns: a zero price must not be stored as zero or it would corrupt downstream price analysis
the ended page is still a listing, so Parse must return a non-null ItemPageListing with only Price absent

criteria.criterion: A non-listing page (anti-bot or catalog) is reported as not a listing, with no partial values.
criteria.plannedImplementation: EbayItemPageParser.Parse returns null when the page lacks the item-page identity (no h1.x-item-title__mainTitle and no item structure), so an anti-bot interstitial or a catalog browse page is reported as not a listing and no partial ItemPageListing is produced.
criteria.plannedVerification: NonListingPageIsNotReportedAsAListingTests.Should_report_an_anti_bot_page_as_not_a_listing and Should_report_a_catalog_page_as_not_a_listing parse an anti-bot interstitial and a catalog browse page and assert Parse returns null. At base Parse throws NotImplementedException so both assertions fail on the missing behaviour. No existing check classifies non-listing pages.
materialConcerns: anti-bot interstitials can contain text and anchors that must not be mistaken for item fields
returning null guarantees no partial values leak to the capture layer
